title: Mayor Mok Shaiz
description: Mok Shaiz was the Ithorian mayor of Mos Espa's metropolitan area. Shaiz rather enjoyed the seat of his power and was wary of anyone who would challenge it. That was why he entered into a deal with the Pykes to challenge Boba Fett for control of the territory of Jabba the Hutt and keep Mos Espa under his thumb. Unfortunately, Boba Fett was more cunning.
